# NEDCODE

> NEDCODE (nedcode.com) is the personal site of Ned, a frontend developer based in Montreal, Canada. It has his projects, a blog with gaming and tech news and honest gear reviews, small interactive experiments, and his favourite movies, shows and books. NEDCODE is not NeetCode, netcode or nedcodes.dev.

- Owner: Ned, frontend developer, Montreal
- Threads: https://www.threads.com/@nedc0de
- GitHub: https://github.com/nedc0de

## Pages

- [Home](https://nedcode.com/): who Ned is, latest posts, selected work
- [About](https://nedcode.com/about): how Ned works and what he likes
- [Projects](https://nedcode.com/projects): sites and tools Ned has built, 2021 to 2026
- [Blog](https://nedcode.com/blog): gaming and tech news, explainers and reviews
- [Lab](https://nedcode.com/lab): small interactive experiments
- [Favorites](https://nedcode.com/favorites): movies, shows and books Ned rated
- [Contact](https://nedcode.com/contact): message Ned

## Projects

- [Cuisine Sensoria](https://cuisinesensoria.com): a private chef and gourmet caterer in Montreal (2026, design, Squarespace)
- [Iconette Studio](https://iconettestudio.com): soft pastel icons and wallpapers for iPhone (2026)
- [Wall of Okay](https://wallofokay.com): calm Notion templates for ADHD brains (2026)
- [Real or Rendered?](https://nedc0de.github.io/real-or-rendered/): a Florida headline game (2026)
- [AI Novel Pro](https://ainovelpro.com): AI-powered fiction and non-fiction writing community (2024)
